exploration_screening.note: Not played in v5 (the candidate is fixed, exploration.fixed_candidate; screen-exploration is refused). Kept so that the v2 schema is satisfied and the rule stays readable. MAIN metric = mean FUNCTION recall over the 6 tasks (maintainer decision 2026-10-06, before the freeze: each task's truth is a single product file and 5 of the 6 screening tasks share linear.py, so file recall is near-trivial). Candidates were the two frozen ones of v3 (in v4 the candidates list holds only qwen3.6-35b-a3b-mlx-4bit, fixed) and the v3 screening was complete only when both had their 6 tasks decided. Eligible = mean file precision >= 0.5; the best mean function recall is compared to retained_function_recall_min BEFORE any tie (below 0.5: STOP 'conserver le cloud', also for a tie; exactly 0.5 is retained); then a tie goes to the shortest total duration, and a tie still unresolved to the candidate listed first in candidates. STOP also when no candidate has mean file precision >= 0.5. File recall is measured and reported but does not decide. A task whose truth has no function (none today) is excluded from the function-recall mean. A refused or contaminated attempt counts 0 on every metric and never blocks the screening: an assumed departure from 'absent data is never zero', limited to this filter (the comparison keeps unknown as unknown). Inherited from v2 and v3; kept readable, not applied in v5.

exploration_comparison.note: arm L is retained only if compatibility AND quality AND economy all pass on the 1 task: its acceptance rate >= A's AND its premium tokens per accepted task (explorer included; local tokens do not count) <= 0.85 x A's, and compatibility (the v1 machine criterion: no external signal, extra swap under extra_swap_gib_max) passes. v5 has no arm E. A task whose arm record is undecided (contaminated, review_unreadable, tool error, cap) is undecided, not failed; quality compares acceptance counts with undecided tasks as bounds. Rule unchanged from v2, v3 and v4; the pilot decides nothing.

exploration_screening.reason: no screening: candidate fixed by the protocol

economy_detail.premium_definition: unweighted sum of the four billing token classes over all models, explorer included (an economy model counts as premium; local tokens do not)
